title: Enhanced Rate Limiting with IP Blocking
description: This feature enhances the existing rate limiting functionality by adding IP blocking capabilities, preventing malicious users from overwhelming the server. It will improve the security and performance of the framework by reducing the load on the server. This feature will also include logging and error handling for production readiness
testCases: Test rate limiting with IP blocking
Test rate limiting with multiple requests from the same IP
acceptance: The feature is accepted when the rate limiting middleware correctly blocks IP addresses that exceed the specified limit and logs the blocked requests
reason: This feature is technically justified as it improves the security and performance of the framework, and is business justified as it provides a more robust and reliable solution for users
